title: Claude Slash Command Format
description: JSON Schema for Claude Code Slash Commands - quick actions triggered by /command-name

allowed-tools.description: List of tools the command can use (inherits from conversation if not specified)

oneOf.description: The arguments expected for the slash command as a string (e.g., 'add [tagId] | remove [tagId] | list')
The arguments expected for the slash command as an array of positional arguments (e.g., ['pr-number', 'priority', 'assignee'])

argument-hint.description: The arguments expected for the slash command. Can be a string or array of positional arguments. Shown when auto-completing the command.

description.description: Brief description of the command (defaults to first line from the prompt if not specified)

model.description: Specific model string (inherits from conversation if not specified)

disable-model-invocation.description: Whether to prevent SlashCommand tool from calling this command

content.description: Markdown content with instructions for executing the command. Can include H1 title with emoji icon.

examples.content:
# 📝 Documentation Generator

Generate comprehensive documentation for the selected code.

## Instructions

- Analyze code structure and purpose
- Generate clear, concise documentation
- Follow JSDoc/TSDoc format for TypeScript

# Tag Manager

Manage tags for project files.

## Usage

- `/tags add <tagId>` - Add a tag
- `/tags remove <tagId>` - Remove a tag
- `/tags list` - List all tags

frontmatter.description: Bulk build GitHub Actions for PRs

examples.content:
# Bulk Build Actions

Build GitHub Actions for multiple PRs.

## Arguments

- `pr-number` - The PR number to build
- `priority` - Build priority (high, normal, low)
- `assignee` - Person responsible for the build
